faqs.question: How long does a typical UI/UX Design engagement take?
faqs.answer: Focused product or website UX usually takes 3–8 weeks from research through high-fidelity UI, depending on scope.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work in Figma, align to your design system, and partner closely with engineering for feasible specs.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Task success, conversion lift, usability findings resolved, design QA pass rates, and stakeholder clarity on flows.

faqs.question: Research included?
faqs.answer: Lightweight research by default — interviews, analytics review, heuristic audit — scaled up when risk warrants deeper studies.

faqs.question: Do you deliver prototypes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Clickable prototypes validate flows before expensive engineering builds the wrong thing.

faqs.question: Design systems or one-off screens?
faqs.answer: We prefer reusable components. Even small projects get tokens and patterns that prevent UI drift.

faqs.question: Can you improve conversion without a full redesign?
faqs.answer: Often. CRO-focused UX on key funnels can outperform a cosmetic redesign.

faqs.question: Handoff to developers?
faqs.answer: Annotated Figma, states/variants, and redlines — plus availability during build for design QA.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Share product goals and current pain points. We propose a UX plan with milestones and review cadence.

faqs.question: Who designs?
faqs.answer: Product/visual designers with UX leadership; content design support when microcopy is blocking conversion.
